intranetModeNotListening: {mode}不监听局域网，其他设备无法把这里当 DNS
{mode} does not listen on the LAN, so other devices cannot use this as their DNS
intranetListeningOn: 已监听 0.0.0.0:{port}，其他设备把 DNS 指到上面的地址
Listening on 0.0.0.0:{port}; point other devices' DNS at the address above
intranetServiceStopped: 服务未启动：启动后才会绑定 {port} 端口
Service not started: port {port} is bound once it starts
